---
title: "Layer points and a fitted line"
---

Plot highway fuel economy against engine displacement, then add a least-squares line with its confidence band.

## Data

`Datasets::mpg()` returns the 234 cars of ggplot2's `mpg` data, bundled with phiz as [`resources/data/mpg.csv`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/resources/data/mpg.csv). The example uses two of its columns:

| displ | hwy |
| ---: | ---: |
| 1.8 | 29 |
| 1.8 | 29 |
| 2.0 | 31 |

`displ` is the engine displacement in liters, and `hwy` is the highway fuel economy in miles per gallon.

## Code

{{< include ../_generated/example-layers-code.md >}}

Runnable scripts: [`layers.php`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/docs/examples/scripts/layers.php) (PHP 8.5+) and [`layers.chain.php`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/docs/examples/scripts/layers.chain.php) (PHP 8.3–8.4).

## Result

{{< include ../_generated/example-layers-output.md >}}

- **Inheritance.** Both layers use the data and the `x` and `y` mappings given to `ggplot()` and `aes()`. A layer can add its own mappings or data, or set `inheritAes: false` to ignore the plot's mappings.
- **The band.** `method: 'lm'` fits a straight line by least squares. The shaded band is a 95% confidence interval for the mean highway economy at each displacement, so most individual cars fall outside it. phiz computes the fit and the band in PHP, and they match R's `predict(fit, interval = "confidence")`. `level:` changes the confidence level, and `se: false` hides the band.
- **The fit.** Cars with larger engines tend to have lower highway economy. At the largest displacements the points rise again, which a straight line cannot follow. The default method, loess, fits a local curve instead ([Fitted curves](../geoms.qmd#fitted-curves)).
- **Transparency.** `alpha: 0.5` makes overlapping points show as darker points.

In R, the same chart is `ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + geom_smooth(method = "lm")`.

**See also:** [`ggplot()`](../reference-plots.qmd#ggplot-function) · [`aes()`](../reference-plots.qmd#aes-function) · [`geom_point()` / `->point()`](../reference-geoms.qmd#point) · [`geom_smooth()` / `->smooth()`](../reference-geoms.qmd#smooth) · [`labs()`](../reference-themes.qmd#labs) · [`save()`](../reference-output.qmd#save)
